name: Analyze
description: API for adding information in the Analyze tab of entities.

suggests.drupal/statistics: Replacement for the deprecated core Statistics module, required for the Node Views submodule.
suggests.drush/drush: Required for the analyze:batch Drush command.

project_description: Analyze provides a framework that adds an "Analyze" tab to every content entity with a canonical URL, giving content editors one consistent place to read per-entity insights instead of hopping between several modules with different UIs. The module itself ships no data collectors: it defines an "Analyze" plugin type, a plugin manager, a base class, an entity-tab controller, dynamic per-entity routes, an access check and a per-content-type settings UI. Analyzer submodules (Basic Content Info, Node Views, Google Analytics, and the example plugin) each contribute one plugin that renders a summary gauge or table plus an optional full report. Site builders toggle which analyzers run on which entity type/bundle from Configuration > Content > Content Analysis, and from each bundle edit form. A Drush command (analyze:batch) can run analyzers across many entities at once, and an Agent Skills file lets AI coding assistants drive analysis in natural language.
